client_needs_summary: Support tickets pile up over the weekend with no triage until Monday morning.
project_scope: A triage bot that categorises incoming tickets by urgency and routes them to the right queue automatically.
goals_and_objectives: Cut Monday-morning backlog and make sure urgent tickets are flagged within the hour, any day of the week.
recommended_services: An AI triage layer in front of their existing helpdesk, plus a weekly accuracy report.
